rules.washout: Washed out: well under the 52-week high after a sharp 20-day drop or a deeply oversold reading, and still close to the 20-day low (funds are judged a little more gently) — or, for calm low-volatility names, a drop that is unusually large for their own volatility.
rules.ladder: XLU-like call ladder (contract level): calls built on still-open expiries — in one session or over a few settles, among the very biggest builds of all names that day, or among the big builders day after day — mostly near the money, calls well ahead of the puts, spread across several expiries rather than piled into one or two contracts, and no sign of call selling.
rules.tiers: X = washed out + XLU-like ladder · W = building: a big build that passes the ladder gates but misses one · J = rejected big builds (spreads, one expiry, call selling…) · Near = the ladder is on, but the washout is one check short or just ended.
rules.score: Order within a tier: X and Near by persistence, then build size; W by build size; J by dollar size.
